children: is expected to retrace into a support zone of $86.52-$90.96 per barrel in the fourth quarter before resuming its uptrend and retesting the resistance at $105.75.
The resistance is identified as the 61.8% projection level of a wave C from $67.03, the third wave of a three-wave cycle from the December 2026 low of $54.98.

This wave could either end around $105.75, or extend to $129.68, its 100% projection level. Based on the size and duration of the preceding wave A and the wave B, the wave C is unlikely to complete around $105.75.

Instead, it is more likely to extend toward $129.68. The current correction is expected to be the same degree as the one from the July 23 high of $93.50, to extend to $86.52, as pointed out by a rising channel.
A weaker correction may end prematurely around $90.96. A break below $86.52 would be a very bearish signal, calling for a revision of the bullish outlook, as the market may drop deeply toward $67.03.

On the weekly chart, the rise from $54.77 is presumed to be the continuation of the uptrend from the April 2020 low of $10.07. The negative $40.32 hit in the same month has not been incorporated in the calculation because it was too extreme.
The rise is driven by a wave C, which is capable of travelling to $129.51, its 61.8% projection level. Based on this reading, the correction around $100.96 might be temporary.
